children: The number of payrolled employees in the UK increased by 13 thousand, or 0.04%, to 30.3 million in September 2026, after a revised 1 thousand rise in the previous month.
This was the largest monthly increase since August 2025.
Compared with a year earlier, employment decreased by 0.2%, or 66 thousand.
Employment rose the most in the administrative and support services sector, adding 66,000 employees, while the wholesale and retail sector recorded the largest decline, shedding 71,000 employees.
Across NUTS3 regions, Derry City and Strabane saw a 1.4% rise in payrolled employees, whereas Camden and City of London registered a 1.7% drop.
Meanwhile, median monthly pay rose by 4.4% year-on-year to £2,660.
Growth in median pay was highest in the other service activities sector (5.6%) and lowest in the transportation and storage sector (1.8%).

title: UK Payroll Employment Rises 13K in September
